column8: ["The narrow rings and flat straps read as a lightweight outline rather than a solid, weighty kiln-floor machine.","Across the plum surfaces and brass rims, the soft color bands barely distinguish glazed ceramic, rubbed metal or matte rubber, and lack convincing contact-edge wear.","The repeated plain collars and nearly featureless straps feel diagrammatic, with little character or crafted detail to reward a closer look."]
